prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / UI production sprites.
Create a clean reusable production asset sheet for the same Chinese Daoist chibi fishing game as the attached artworks. Image 1 approved mail UI and Image 2 approved team UI define the exact art family: jade/teal, warm ivory silk-paper, fine warm gold borders, rounded ruyi/cloud forms, high-definition delicate hand-painted highlights and shading, restrained jade/metal quality. Image 3 shows the corresponding current game control or inventory design and is a fidelity reference.
This is a transparent asset sheet, not a screen mockup or presentation: no background scenery, characters, text, numbers, labels, words, headings, watermark, floor, shadow ground, checkerboard paint, cards behind the requested assets or grid lines. Genuine transparent RGBA background between assets. Each asset is isolated and complete, centered in its equal grid cell, with at least 12 percent transparent gap to every cell edge. All silhouettes remain wholly within their own cell. No item may touch or overlap adjacent cells. Keep exact row-major order. Distinct states change rendering rather than adding a word. Match the restrained polished approved source, avoid glossy plastic or photorealism. Native detail, crisp smooth alpha edges.
Canvas approximately 4:3, exactly FOUR equal columns and THREE equal rows. Twelve assets in strict row-major order. Row1: jade primary normal / jade primary pressed (slightly darker inset) / primary disabled (desaturated taupe jade and low gold) / primary selected (gentle fine gold active rim). Row2: ivory secondary normal / secondary pressed (slightly darker inset ivory) / secondary disabled (desaturated warm gray) / secondary selected (subtle jade edge and gold rim). All first eight are same wide rounded button geometry, cloud-ruyi ends, completely blank, each centered, occupying about 72% cell width and 35% cell height, no labels. Row3: ivory tab normal with restrained thin gold edge / jade tab selected with fine gold edge / circular jade close normal with one ivory X glyph / circular jade close pressed darker inset with one ivory X glyph. Tab same size family as buttons. Close circles about 45% cell height and width no larger than that. The X on last two is the only permitted symbol, all other buttons blank. Exactly twelve assets, no extra buttons.
